prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person’s hand typing on a laptop keyboard, with the screen displaying a bold, orange and white interface featuring Turkish text. The focus is on the hand, which is illuminated by the cool, bluish glow of the screen, creating a strong contrast with the warm, ambient lighting in the background. The laptop is angled slightly from the side, emphasizing the depth of the keyboard and the sleek, modern design of the device. The composition draws attention to the action of typing, with the hand partially obscuring some keys, and the text on the screen reading “ADAY İŞLEMLERİ SİSTEMİ GİRİŞ” in a prominent black bar. The background is softly blurred, enhancing the sense of intimacy and concentration. The overall color palette balances the warmth of the environment with the stark, digital light of the screen, evoking a late-night, focused atmosphere. The style is realistic, with a shallow depth of field and a subtle cinematic quality, as if captured in a thoughtful, documentary-inspired film.
